## Recipe summary

Brief description of what the recipe does and the use case it solves.

## Checklist

- [ ] Recipe tested on a real ActionKit instance
- [ ] `README.md` follows the fat structure (see `recipes/_TEMPLATE/README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
- [ ] Snippet includes an `{% else %}` fallback branch
- [ ] `snippet.txt` (clean) and `snippet-tagged.txt` (with UTM measurement tags) both included
- [ ] Tested as new user, returning user, and user missing the relevant variable
- [ ] Credits any prior public work the recipe adapts
- [ ] "How to know if it's working" section names the metric to compare
